description: §24.5: a <span> directly inside a <table> is E-HTML-PARSER-REPAIR. The HTML parser moves it out of the table ("foster parenting").
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S474 "⭐ RULED — FORK RULE row C amended: semantic impossibility may be PERMANENT" (the PERMANENT class); the code and its reading are a PA reading in the S474 review of #1727 (F3 h_tableSpan: show= hid the wrong element in Chromium)
rationale: §24.5 item 2: a child of <table> other than caption / colgroup / thead / tbody / tfoot SHALL be E-HTML-PARSER-REPAIR.
